[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for landscape photography: Shoot during the golden hour, chase the clouds, pay attention to composition, bracket shots, slow down, experiment with angles, and pay attention to the foreground.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for capturing natural light: Shoot in RAW, use graduated ND filters, look for soft light, avoid harsh midday sun, and shoot in the right direction.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Manual focus tips: Use live view, focus peaking, zone focusing, and hyper-focal distance.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips to make the photography project engaging: Define a theme, create a visual diary, experiment with different genres, play with lighting, tell a story, get creative with composition, and develop a consistent post-processing style.
